"""Reproduce: Prefetch objects don't work with slices (#26780)."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.auth",
        "tests.prefetch_related",
    ],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from tests.prefetch_related.models import Author, Book  # noqa: E402
from django.db.models import Prefetch  # noqa: E402
from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment  # noqa: E402
from django.test.runner import DiscoverRunner  # noqa: E402

setup_test_environment()
runner = DiscoverRunner(interactive=False, verbosity=0)
old_config = runner.setup_databases()

a1 = Author.objects.create(name="a1")
a2 = Author.objects.create(name="a2")
a3 = Author.objects.create(name="a3")
b1 = Book.objects.create(title="b1")
b1.authors.set([a1, a2, a3])

# The exact scenario from the ticket, on the reverse FK-ish m2m:
try:
    list(
        Author.objects.prefetch_related(
            Prefetch("book_set", queryset=Book.objects.all()[:3], to_attr="example")
        )
    )
    print("REVERSE FK (book_set): OK")
except Exception as e:
    print("REVERSE FK (book_set): FAIL ->", type(e).__name__, e)

try:
    list(
        Book.objects.prefetch_related(
            Prefetch("authors", queryset=Author.objects.all()[:2], to_attr="example")
        )
    )
    print("M2M FORWARD (authors): OK")
except Exception as e:
    print("M2M FORWARD (authors): FAIL ->", type(e).__name__, e)

runner.teardown_databases(old_config)
